messages:
Mia: Quick check — onboarding for harbor8b-slim (catalog id: harbor8b-slim,v=2026-03-17). Need weights path, tokenizer sanity, and perf plan. Planning a smoke perf run tomorrow 10:30 PT. @Ashok @Tess @Sam
Ashok: Weights are uploaded to s3://redwood-models/harbor8b-slim/weights/commit-1a2b3c. Manifest at s3://redwood-models/harbor8b-slim/manifest.json (schema v2). Please point the /catalog/harbor8b-slim symlink to that s3 path for staging. Note: a few checkpoint shards are named shard_00a instead of shard_000 — loader handles it but it's flagged in the manifest.
Sam: Tokenizer quick note — HF tokenizer.json is missing bos_token and special token mappings are sparse. We saw token count spikes for URLs and some emojis. Run:
```
python -m tools.tokenizer.inspect --model-dir /catalog/harbor8b-slim --sample "https://example.com/test"
```
This prints token ids and special tokens. Suggest adding bos_token '<s>' and set truncation_side: right in the config.
Tess: Config validation done locally. I pushed config to /catalog/harbor8b-slim/config.yaml — key bits:
```
max_seq_len: 2048
kv_cache: true
quant: int8
batching:
  preferred_batch: 4
  max_latency_ms: 250
```
Run infra validation: `infra validate-config /catalog/harbor8b-slim/config.yaml`
Infra-Bot: deploy-check: manifest schema OK, weight file checksums OK, config lint passed (warnings: quant int8 requires kernel fallback on cuda12).
Jordan: Perf plan (two phases):
- latency smoke: batches 1,2,4; concurrency 1; payload 64 tokens; rbench v0.9
- throughput sweep: batches 8,16,32; concurrency 8,16,32; sustained 5m each
Use route `serve-staging-eu-west-1` and measure p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. tagging: team=eng-ml, model=harbor8b-slim
Command example:
```
rbench run --model /catalog/harbor8b-slim --route serve-staging-eu-west-1 --tool rps --payload 64 --batches 1,2,4 --concurrency 1
```
Mia: Ran a quick smoke on local staging — sample output:
```
batch=1 p50=32ms p95=78ms p99=130ms
batch=4 p50=45ms p95=110ms p99=220ms
```
Looks acceptable. Noting that enabling prefix_cache reduced p95 ~7% on short prompts.
Ashok: Re: tokenizer — I'll add bos_token and push updated tokenizer.json + tokenizers configuration, then regenerate tokenizer tests. ETA: today EOD.
Tess: I'll enable quant kernel fallback tests in infra for the job and run a compatibility smoke with cuda12 images.
Sam: Heads-up — tokenization mismatch can affect evals. I'll add a small url-heavy prompt set to the eval job to catch token count regressions.
Mia: Action items: Ashok (update tokenizer) / Tess (kernel fallback tests + infra smoke) / Jordan (run full throughput sweep tomorrow 10:30 PT) / Sam (add eval prompts). I'll kick off the perf run and post results here. :thumbsup:
